tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (9.8:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: bg-primary
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stage-seed`, `.stage-series-a`, `.calendar-event`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `nav a:hover`, `.btn-outline`. 19.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Used as text on `nav a`, `.hero-subtitle`, `.company-tagline`. 9.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: growth-up
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.metric-value.up`, `.status-completed`, `.stat-card-change.positive`; border on `.milestone-item.completed`. 14.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: metric-yellow
tokens.usage: Used as border on `.milestone-item.upcoming`; text on `.status-upcoming`. 13.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: btn-outline-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: shadow/glow on `.btn-primary:hover`; border on `.btn-outline:hover`, `.card:hover`, `.company-card:hover`; background on `.btn-outline:hover`, `.milestone-item.active`, `.status-active`. 5.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: focus-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: border on `.investor-card:hover`; shadow/glow on `.investor-card:hover`; background on `.focus-tag`. 9.4:1 on `page-bg`.

families.display: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1.hero-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3.company-name` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `p.company-tagline` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels — as `button.btn` on the reference page. The reference page leaves this element on the browser default face; set it in the body family.
